objective: Lemmas 1 to 3 by hand; the frozen exact census of certificates for every word of odd period 3 to 29, with the harmony-word control; the fresh-code referee; the proof attempt for every odd period.
status: Proved 2026-11-12: lemmas 1 to 4 (the mirror pairs odd orbits but forbids nothing; flip certificates rule out every harmony allowing a word; a word of odd period without one would itself give a harmony of span less than its period); computer-assisted, refereed by fresh code and an independent session: every word of odd period 3 to 29 has a certificate, so no not-all-equal harmony has a state of odd period at most 29.
title: Flip certificates for odd-period words
